posts.body:
The title says it all. I want to make a battle ui for a single character that would look like this:
From what i heard HUD Maker Ultra should do the job, but I'm not really sure if that is going to work as i use couple of Visustella's plugins that add it's own battle commands (Boost and Unboost commands to be exact). Is there someone experienced with HUD Maker Ultra? Is it Visustella compatible, is it buggy, will it work with the most recent RPG Maker MZ version as intended?

Well... I tried it before, but from what i can tell this plugin only allows to add specific things like gauges, pictures, or texts. It doesn't allow to change the button layout or anything like that, so i thought maybe i just missed something while watching tutorials? xD
I looked through some forum and Reddit threads before where others were searching for tools or plugins to make big changes to the UI. A lot of people kept saying, "Just use HUD Maker!", so i though maybe it has some secret functionality or something?
That is why i made this post, just to make it clear for myself if that plugin really can do what i need, or either get some helpful tips? I mean, there has to be a way to change the UI, right?
Anyway, sorry for not clarifying this at first!

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: A HUD is a HUD a UI is a UI. To different things. If you want changes to the UI, you'll need something else/custom.
